name: Prism
description: The pointer draws a stroke of light that splits into its colours. At rest the stroke is a single white filament. As the pointer speeds up the filament spreads across the width of the stroke into the full spectrum, cyan along one edge and rose along the other, and it draws back together the moment the hand slows. A click throws the split wide open for an instant.
author: PlasmaZones

parameters.name: Width
parameters.description: Width the spectrum is spread across (px)

parameters.name: Lifetime
parameters.description: How long a point on the path stays lit (seconds)

parameters.name: Dispersion
parameters.description: How far the colours spread apart at full speed, 0 to keep one white filament

parameters.name: Spread speed
parameters.description: Pointer speed at which the colours are fully spread (px per second)

parameters.name: Glow
parameters.description: Strength of the soft bloom around the stroke

parameters.name: Activation speed
parameters.description: Pointer speed below which the stroke is not drawn (px per second), 0 to always draw

parameters.name: Smoothing
parameters.description: How much the path is smoothed before it is drawn, 0 to follow it exactly

parameters.name: Click flare
parameters.description: How far a click throws the split open, 0 to disable
